//#typecheck:tooling.description: Hash the root compiler's include tree: the tooling under scripts/, which imports no workspace package (the repository superlint's program isolation refuses one). The rule fixtures compile in programs of their own.

//#lint:repository.description: Hash the tooling's source and the root manifest the repository rules read; program isolation keeps every workspace package out of this program, and the rule fixtures compile in programs of their own.

//#lint:fixtures.description: Hash superlint and the style linter with their rules and fixtures, the app's design system and class helper the style fixtures compile against, and the oxlint plugin's rules and their RuleTester cases: every rule must report exactly its fixtures' marked lines and its invalid cases.

//#lint:oxlint.description: Hash oxlint operands, their compiler configuration, the plugin and Git ignore rules; type-aware rules read the app's route declarations.

//#style:check.description: Hash every Git-visible operand of the app's program (its source and the workspace packages it loads) and of the design system, excluding non-operands and the rule fixtures. Class analysis reads no generated route declaration, so typegen is no dependency.

//#format:check.description: Hash every Git-visible file oxfmt walks from the root, which follows the Git ignore rules, and the formatter configuration; files it cannot format are no operands.

//#lint:dead-code.description: Hash every workspace's source, manifests and compiler configuration, and fallow's configuration.

source.description: Hash transitive workspace source without running no-emit checks in dependency order.

//#db:test.description: Rebuilds the local cluster's throwaway superstarter_test database from the migrations, once per test run, before any suite reads it.

test.description: Integration suites against the throwaway database //#db:test just rebuilt; the database is their input, so they never cache.
